svg.metadata: Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 scale-rank minor-islands dataset; Malta, Gozo and Comino; WGS84; illustrated treatment: JOURNEY ATLAS

g.desc: Basemap 2.0.0 / GSHHG 2.3.6 intermediate-resolution sampling within the aspect-fitted Malta viewport resolves only the same three major domestic island groups represented by the approved target: Malta, Gozo and Comino. No independently supported foreign land falls inside this frame, so no pale surrounding-land path is drawn. Approved national path unchanged.
